name: BMW E9x/E8x Car Interface
author: catpilot
description: BMW E9x/E8x car interface with VIN-based detection, DCC control, and stepper servo steering. Safety model (bmw.h) is compiled C on STM32.

CruiseCeilingMemory.description: Remember cruise speed ceiling across disengage/re-engage within same drive

TemperatureOverlay.description: Show coolant and oil temperature on the onroad HUD

HoldHysteresis.description: Hysteresis on the steering rest band: leave rest at 0.0015 rad error, settle at 0.001. Write 0 to disable (legacy single threshold).

StallBreakaway.description: Shed steering torque when a stalled rack breaks away and sweeps more than 2 degrees at speed. Write 1 to enable. Read at drive start.
